decision.next_action: If this gate fails, do not launch a MIS-LSTM Kaggle runner. If it passes, run a separate no-submit artifact/runner contract review before any remote execution.

feature_contract.domain_read: Q3 uses day/evening load and transition blocks. S3 uses pre-sleep/onset blocks with no-screen, dark, charging, stillness, and rest channels. S4 uses post-onset/morning-tail interruption blocks. This is a low-capacity feasibility proxy for MIS-LSTM, not a neural runner.

purpose: Bounded local feasibility gate for MIS-LSTM-style multi-hour block sequences after 22 registered post-ID342 routes closed.
